name: wapimaji-mcp
description: Kenya drought-response MCP toolkit: simulated county drought phases (no real NDMA data yet), confirmed SMS alerts, coordination events

tools.name: get_drought_status
tools.description: SIMULATED drought phase for a Kenyan county: the values are generated from the county name, are NOT NDMA data and not an observation, and every answer says synthetic true. Use only to build and test flows, never for decisions. An unknown county returns an error; in live mode it returns an explicit not-implemented error because no data source is integrated. Returns county, phase, phase label, rainfall deficit percent, population affected, synthetic true, the source and a note. Read-only.

tools.name: get_drought_alerts
tools.description: List SIMULATED county drought alerts at or above a minimum phase (1 minimal, 2 stressed, 3 crisis, 4 emergency, 5 famine; default 3). Use only to build and test flows: this is sandbox data, not NDMA observation, and production returns an explicit not-implemented error. Returns the counties at that phase with population affected, the count, the phase queried and its label, sandbox true and the source. Read-only.

tools.name: sms_drought_alert
tools.description: Send a drought alert SMS through Africa's Talking. Use only when the user has explicitly approved this exact message and recipient list. SENDS TO REAL PEOPLE: real messages go out only when SANDBOX=false and confirm_send=true; otherwise it simulates and reports the recipient count without contacting the provider. Returns sent, count and the provider response, or an error. Messages are limited to 160 characters. Sending cannot be undone.

tools.name: publish_drought_coordination
tools.description: Publish a drought coordination event to africa-coord-bus so other servers can react (insurance evaluation, advisories, malnutrition watch, county alerts). Use when coordinating a drought response across servers. Phases 2 stressed, 3 crisis and 4 emergency trigger coordination; phase 0 takes the phase and deficit from get_drought_status, which is SIMULATED data. Returns published false with a reason if africa-coord-bus is not installed. Side effect: emits an event to the bus.

relatedServers.name: civic-agent-kit
relatedServers.description: Kenya civic data MCP (budget, parliament, SACCO, rights)

envVars.name: AT_USERNAME
envVars.description: Africa's Talking username. Use 'sandbox' for testing.

envVars.name: AT_API_KEY
envVars.description: Africa's Talking API key for SMS alerts
